req.title: Reject negative squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when squadNumber is not a positive integer.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-023 requires HTTP 422 when squadNumber is not a positive integer. The violation was test[5] having kind=negative but heuristic=EP. A negative test must use heuristic=NEG (or BVA if boundary-focused). Fix: change test[5] heuristic from EP to NEG, since it is testing a representative value from the invalid equivalence class using a negative testing approach. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_positive_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 27 is not present in the pre-loaded dataset
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid payload where squadNumber=27 (a positive integer not in the pre-loaded set)
expected: Response body contains squadNumber equal to 27
Response body contains firstName equal to the submitted value
trace: R-PLAYER-023: positive integer squadNumber must be accepted (EP — valid partition)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_positive_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert "id" in body

tests.name: test_post_player_squad_number_one_accepted_as_positive_boundary
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
squadNumber=1 is the smallest positive integer; it IS taken in the pre-loaded dataset so expect 409 (not 422), confirming validation passed
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber=1 (smallest positive integer, already taken)
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict is returned (not 422), proving squadNumber=1 passed positivity validation and reached duplicate-check logic
trace: R-PLAYER-023: squadNumber=1 is the positive boundary; receiving 409 (not 422) proves the value was accepted as valid by the validator — BVA boundary+1 from zero
